subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime, persistent schema, Gateway/CLI inspection APIs, plugin SDK additions, worker/startup behavior, and environment controls as a supported core product boundary?
rationale: This is not a narrow repair: it establishes new persistent and public contracts whose permanence, release scope, upgrade behavior, and operational support burden require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the durable core
options.body: Approve the architecture and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, reset, and restart proof before merging the ordered stack.

options.title: Narrow to internal handoff
options.body: Retain only the minimal internal recovery seam and defer the new public runtime, protocol, CLI, SDK, worker, and inspection surfaces.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Defer the cumulative PRs until a maintainer-sponsored architecture decision defines the durable core contract and landing sequence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable core
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, reset, and restart proof before merging the ordered stack.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent merged agent/session runtime work and was identified by the prior feature-history routing as a strong reviewer for the lifecycle boundary.
